source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of design for accessibility (PDF 190).

items: Parhne mein aasan fonts: wazeh, bare fonts jaise Arial ya Times New Roman, sajawati andaaz ki bajaye.
Tasveeron ka alternative text: tasveeron, charts aur graphs ki tafseel likhein ta ke nazar se mehroom users, jo screen readers istemal kar sakte hain, samajh sakein.

blocks.prompt: Accessible digital content banana aur sab ko shamil karne ki tadabeer samjhaiye (long question 5).
blocks.explanation: Accessible mawad shuru se tamam users ke liye banaya jata hai. Chapter ki tadabeer: wazeh, bare fonts aur tasveeron aur charts ka alternative text. Mazeed aam tareeqe: rangon ka wazeh farq, audio aur video ke captions ya transcripts, screen readers ke samajhne wale headings aur labels, sirf keyboard se istemal ke qabil mawad, aur saada zaban. Maazoor afraad samait users se feedback lena batata hai ke kya theek karna baqi hai. Mazeed tareeqe aam ilm hain.

items: Accessibility: parhne mein aasan fonts aur alt text, aur contrast, captions aur screen reader ke liye munasib dhancha.
